etymology: Compound ideograph: jade (王王) divided by the blade (刂) — shares distributed to groups: a squad, a team.
mnemonic: The treasure split, one piece per team — ハン. 班長: keeper of the piece.

etymology: Phono-semantic: originally altar (示) + 必 (phonetic ヒ) — what the gods keep to themselves: secret.
mnemonic: Locked with a stake through it (必) — ひめる. 秘密: the kanji that begs to be told.

etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 表 (phonetic ヒョウ) — the straw bale a person shoulders: a bag of rice; the sumo ring's border.
mnemonic: The rice bale, and the ring made of them — たわら. 土俵: where sumo lives.

etymology: Compound ideograph: a great bird (大+隹) beating up from the field (田) — bursting upward: roused, energized.
mnemonic: Wings exploding out of the paddy — ふるう. 興奮: takeoff, emotionally.

etymology: Phono-semantic: mound (阝) + a phonetic — the steps of the throne one addresses from below: Majesty (陛下).
mnemonic: You speak to the stairs, not the throne — ヘイ. 陛下: 'below the steps', etiquette fossilized.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 莫 (phonetic マク) + cloth (巾) — the great hanging cloth: curtain; the general's curtained camp: the shogunate (幕府).
mnemonic: The cloth that hid a government — マク. 幕が上がる: history and theater share the verb.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 宓 (phonetic ミツ) + mountain (山) — hidden close in the hills: secret; packed close: dense.
mnemonic: Deep in the mountains, packed tight — ミツ. 秘密 and 密度: hidden things and crowded ones.

etymology: Compound: the oath sworn over the blood dish (皿) under heaven's lights (明) — a sworn alliance.
mnemonic: The pact sealed at the bright bowl — メイ. 同盟, 連盟: leagues great and sporting.

etymology: Phono-semantic: wood (木) + 莫 (phonetic モ) — the wooden mold things are copied from: model, pattern.
mnemonic: The template everything traces — モ. 模様 patterns cloth; 規模 patterns scale.

etymology: Phono-semantic (simplified from 譯): words (言) + a phonetic — words carried across languages: to translate; the sense behind words: reason (わけ).
mnemonic: Meaning measured into another tongue — やく, わけ. 申し訳ない: 'no explanation can be measured out' — the deep apology.

etymology: Phono-semantic: a phonetic + 見 'see' — looking over the whole: to peruse, view.
mnemonic: Eyes sweeping the full inventory — ラン. ご覧ください: the honorific sweep.

etymology: Compound: the bowed eye (臣) bent over many things (品) — overlooking from above: to face, attend, be present at.
mnemonic: Leaning over the situation in person — のぞむ. 臨時: presence improvised — 'temporary'.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 良 (phonetic ロウ) + moon (月) — clear as moonlight: bright, sonorous.
mnemonic: A voice with moonlight in it — ほがらか. 朗読: reading aloud, silver-toned.

etymology: Pictograph: the cross-shaped plan of an ancient tomb chamber — borrowed for 'second-rank' (亜熱帯) and to transcribe Asia (亜細亜).
mnemonic: The floor plan that named a continent — ア. 亜熱帯: one rank below tropical.

etymology: Phono-semantic: mouth (口) muffled in the garment (衣) — the cry into the sleeve: grief, pity.
mnemonic: Weeping into the collar — あわれ. 哀しい: 悲しい's more literary tears.

etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 屋 (phonetic アク) — the closing fist: to grip, grasp.
mnemonic: Fingers closing like a roof over the palm — にぎる. 握手 shakes; おにぎり feeds.

etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 及 (phonetic キュウ) — the hand dealing with what it reaches: to handle, treat.
mnemonic: Whatever lands in reach becomes your job — あつかう. 取り扱い注意: handle with this kanji.

etymology: Compound: the matriarch under arms — awe-inspiring authority: dignity, menace.
mnemonic: Power that doesn't raise its voice — イ. 威力: force, dressed formally.

etymology: Compound: originally a hand pressing flat (the root of 慰) — the officer who keeps ranks pressed in order: lieutenant.
mnemonic: The one who irons the ranks flat — イ. 大尉: captain of creases.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 尉 'press smooth' (phonetic イ) + heart (心) — smoothing the heart: to console, comfort.
mnemonic: Ironing the wrinkles out of someone's chest — なぐさめる. 慰める: the gentlest verb with a soldier inside.

etymology: Pictograph: a hand leading an elephant to work — to do, to make; the doing-for: sake (ため).
mnemonic: Getting an elephant to work: the original verb 'to do' — ため. 為に: for the sake of; 行為: the deed.

etymology: Phono-semantic: thread (糸) + 隹 (phonetic イ) — the holding cord: fiber; to hold together: maintain.
mnemonic: The tether that keeps the bird — イ. 維持: holding the line; 明治維新: re-tying the whole state.

etymology: Phono-semantic: thread (糸) + 韋 (phonetic イ) — the crosswise weft thread: woof; the earth's crosswise lines: latitude.
mnemonic: The thread running east-west — イ. 緯度: the loom lines of the globe.

etymology: Complex variant of 一 used on documents so no one can forge a stroke: the legal 'one'.
mnemonic: 一 in a business suit — イチ. 金壱万円: one, notarized.

etymology: Compound: the rabbit (兎) bolting down the road (辶) — slipping away: to deviate, be lost; running ahead of the pack: excel.
mnemonic: The rabbit off the path — イツ. 逸話: the story that escaped the official record.

etymology: Phono-semantic: grain (禾) + a phonetic — the standing rice plant: rice in the field.
mnemonic: Rice before it's 米: still green, still bowing — いね. 稲妻: lightning, 'the rice's wife', ripener of grain.

etymology: Phono-semantic: plants (艹) + 于 (phonetic ウ) — the swollen root: taro, potato.
mnemonic: The plant whose treasure is underground — いも. 焼き芋: winter's street-corner kanji.

etymology: Phono-semantic: woman (女) + 因 (phonetic イン) — the alliance made through marriage: matrimony.
mnemonic: The cause (因) two families sign — イン. 婚姻届: love's paperwork.

etymology: Compound: the cloudy (云) side of the hill (阝) — the dark north face: shade, yin.
mnemonic: 陽's other slope — かげ. 陰で: in the shadows, where gossip lives.

etymology: Phono-semantic: mound (阝) + a phonetic — tucked behind the hill: to hide.
mnemonic: Behind the hill, behind the hands, behind the heart — かくす. 隠れ家: the hideout café.

etymology: Phono-semantic: sound (音) + 員 (phonetic イン) — sounds that answer each other: rhyme, resonance.
mnemonic: Echo on the payroll — イン. 韻を踏む: stepping on the rhyme, the rapper's kanji.

etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 咼 (phonetic カ) — water turning on itself: a vortex.
mnemonic: The drain's spiral signature — うず. 渦: Naruto's namesake swirl.

etymology: Phono-semantic: mouth (口) + 貝 (phonetic バイ) — Japan's character for folk song: the shamisen ballad.
mnemonic: A song worth shells — うた. 小唄: the teahouse setlist.

etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 甫 (phonetic ホ) — the sheltered shore: inlet, bay.
mnemonic: The cove where boats overnight — うら. 浦島太郎: the bay's most famous commuter.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 景 'light-scene' (phonetic エイ) + 彡 'strokes' — what light draws behind things: shadow, silhouette.
mnemonic: The scenery's dark copy — かげ. 影武者: the shadow that stands in for the general.

etymology: Phono-semantic: words (言) + 永 'long' (phonetic エイ) — words drawn out long: to chant, compose verse.
mnemonic: Vowels stretched toward forever — よむ. 詠む: what poets do to syllables.

etymology: Phono-semantic: sickness (疒) + 殳 (phonetic エキ) — disease on forced march: epidemic.
mnemonic: Illness with a weapon — エキ. 免疫: the body's standing army against it.

etymology: Phono-semantic: heart (忄) + 兌 'loosen' (phonetic エツ) — the heart unknotted: delight.
mnemonic: The knot in the chest slips free — エツ. ご満悦: visibly, smugly pleased.

etymology: Phono-semantic: words (言) + 曷 (phonetic エツ) — formally requesting to speak before the throne: an audience.
mnemonic: Words admitted past the guards — エツ. 謁見: the throne-room appointment.

etymology: Phono-semantic: gate (門) + 兌 (phonetic エツ) — checked one by one at the gate: to inspect, peruse.
mnemonic: Every page shows its papers at the gate — エツ. 閲覧室: the reading room; 検閲: the gate gone wrong.

etymology: Phono-semantic: roof (宀) + 妟 'ease' (phonetic エン) — feasting at ease under the roof: banquet.
mnemonic: The party the roof was built for — エン. 宴会: bonenkai's formal name.

etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 爰 'rope passed down' (phonetic エン) — the hand on the rescue rope: to aid.
mnemonic: Grab the rope, pull them up — エン. 応援: aid delivered by shouting.

etymology: Compound ideograph: fire on fire (火火) — blaze; the body's blaze: inflammation (〜炎).
mnemonic: Twice the fire — ほのお. 炎上: bonfires and internet comment sections.

etymology: Phono-semantic: beast (犭) + 袁 (phonetic エン) — the long-armed climber: monkey.
mnemonic: The beast in the trailing sleeves — さる. 猿も木から落ちる: even this kanji falls sometimes.

etymology: Phono-semantic: thread (糸) + 彖 (phonetic エン) — the hem-thread where things meet: edge; the unseen thread between people: fate, affinity.
mnemonic: The invisible string that put you both on the same train — えん. ご縁があれば: 'if the thread allows'.

etymology: Compound: abundance (豊) of color (色) — lustrous: glossy, alluring.
mnemonic: Color with the volume up — つや. 艶やか: lacquer, hair, and rumor.

etymology: Phono-semantic: metal (金) + 㕣 (phonetic エン) — the soft grey metal: lead.
mnemonic: The heaviest pencil ancestor — なまり. 鉛筆: lead's daily gig, graphite notwithstanding.

etymology: Pictograph: a shape with a dent in the top — concave. Its partner 凸 bulges.
mnemonic: The kanji IS the dent — オウ. 凹凸: bumps and hollows, drawn literally; へこむ: feeling like the shape looks.
